messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding a new customer org tomorrow (Acme Analytics). Need a cross-cloud provisioning checklist focused on GPU quotas, networking limits, and tagging so the SREs and infra PMs can kick off requests. Posting a compact run-through we can paste into support tickets / internal request forms. :clipboard: 

maria: CHECKLIST (compact):
- Accounts: create org-level entity + billing account (AWS master acct, GCP org, Azure tenant). Link billing before requesting quotas.
- IAM: org-admin group, infra-service-sa, read-only security audit role. Enforce MFA + SCIM for SC teams.
- Tags/labels: `team`, `env`, `owner`, `project`, `cost-center`. Apply at org account / project creation.
- Networking: reserve VPC ranges (avoid 10.0.0.0/8 overlap), create shared VPCs for prod/staging, request increased ENI / elastic IPs if >50 instances expected.
- GPU quotas: request vCPU + GPU quota increase up front. For training/large inference: request NVIDIA A100 (or A10) quota in region(s). For inference fleets, request 1-2x target capacity per region for burst/scale safety.
- Limits (examples): AWS: `p3`/`p4`instance quota, ENA, EBS throughput. GCP: GPU quota per region + preemptible quotas. Azure: NC/ND series quota + low-priority VM quotas.
- Network services: NAT gateway count, LB (ALB/NLB) quota, reserved IPs, subnet IP counts. Consider adding private service connect or endpoints for cloud-managed services.
- Security & Compliance: KMS key policy template, syslog/forwarding destinations, SIEM ingest quota.
- Tags on billing: ensure billing export enabled and tags flow to billing.
- Terraform/automation: store org bootstrap in infra repo, mark state backend (S3/GCS).

maria: SUPPORT TICKET TEMPLATE (paste into provider portal):
```
Subject: Quota increase & org setup for new customer org - Acme Analytics
Project/Account: <account-id> / <org-name>
Requested changes:
- Increase GPU quota: +8 A100 GPUs in us-west-2 (target: 16 total)
- Increase vCPU quota: +512 vCPU in us-west-2
- Increase ENI / Elastic IPs: +100
- Increase NAT gateway quota: +3
- Request support for placement groups / capacity reservations for p4d instances
Reason: Production inference fleet for low-latency model serving (Redwood Dedicated).
ETA: 3 weeks (need capacity reserved by yyyy-mm-dd)
Contact: maria@redwood.ai, +1-555-0102
```

maria: Example IAM snippet to paste into onboarding ticket (AWS):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/infra-service"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}
  ]
}
```

vikram: Nice, added a note: include quota for GPUDriver agents + autoscaling headrooms. We usually request 20% extra for initial buffer. :white_check_mark:

olivia: @maria where should we store the Terraform bootstrap? infra/org-bootstrap or infra/cloud-onboarding? prefer the latter for discoverability. Also we need a runbook entry about tag enforcement via org SCPs.

maria: Put it in infra/cloud-onboarding and I'll add the SCP examples. Good call on tag enforcement.

sam: For Azure, don't forget to request quota in both the region and the subscription. Azure support usually needs the subscription-level SKU request for NC/ND. Also request accelerated networking cap if using GPUS.

maria: Thanks. I'll add Azure bullets. Also note: for GCP, request GPUs on new projects + ask quotas for both standard and preemptible GPUs if we'll use them.

provisioning-bot: Reminder: open internal ticket #INFRA-612 with subject "Acme org provisioning" and attach the support ticket template.

maria: Created INFRA-612 and linked to the onboarding PR. Tagging @cloud-support to start provider requests.

cloud-support: Got it — will draft AWS & GCP support tickets today. Quick question: target A100 vs A10? A100 is overkill for inference; A10 or A30 recommended unless they need fp16 training. Decision means different quota types.

maria: For Acme, they want high throughput small-batch inference with occasional retraining. Go for mixed fleet: A10s for inference, A100s reserved for training windows. Request both but prioritize A10 capacity in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.

vikram: Also FYI: set up capacity reservations for p4d/p3d if we need guaranteed spot-free capacity during retrain windows. We'll add notes to the ticket.

olivia: Will update the onboarding doc with tag examples and SCP snippet. I'll also add a checklist item: "verify billing export to BigQuery/S3 within 48h of account creation."

maria: Perfect. If no blockers I'll close this thread after tickets are opened. Thanks folks. :rocket:
